bingo.centre_note: 2026-08-02: x corrected from 2.316. BuildBingo() derives far_edge_x = centre.x + width/2 (not the stored far_edge_x field below, which is unused by code and only kept as documentation); the old centre.x put the shelf's back face only 16.5mm from the bingo_end wall (x=2.8025), which the user confirmed in Unity Play was wrong. Set so the shelf's back face sits 300mm off the wall (far_edge_x = 2.8025-0.300 = 2.5025, centre.x = 2.5025-width/2). This assumes the rulebook's '300' dimension applies to wall clearance as well as the shelf's own lateral depth (depth_each_side) -- the user only confirmed the latter meaning directly; the wall-clearance reuse is this session's best-effort inference, not independently confirmed. Re-verify against the rulebook if this matters for scoring/collision precision.
bingo.far_edge_x_note: 2026-08-02: this field is NOT read by RoboconFieldBuilder.BuildBingo() (it derives the shelf's back face itself from centre.x + width/2); kept here only as documentation and updated to stay consistent with the corrected centre.x above.
